✦ THE SWIM CYCLE

FROG SWIM SCHOOL / 20 SECONDS

Kick. Pull. Repeat.

Press the four colored limb buttons in the glowing order: left foot, left hand, right foot, right hand.

Every clean stroke adds speed and combo. Wrong or frantic strokes cost energy. The river current slowly pushes sideways, while left and right limbs help correct your line.

Keyboard: A/D front hands · J/K rear feet · Escape pauses.
